env: A Harbor-hosted 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell environment (`{{platform}}`) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, NGC credentials, and the VSS repository at `{{repo_root}}`. This runtime eval builds and deploys the RT-CV person-detection delta on the current `search` developer profile. The build label `in-2-runtime` is directory metadata only. Detection events must reach Kafka topic `mdx-raw` and Elasticsearch; streamed and uploaded media must remain retrievable through VIOS.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-agent` to build and deploy under `_builds/in-2-runtime/`: "Provide streaming and on-demand person detection and multi-object tracking with RT-DETR on RT-CV. Preserve VIOS playback. Publish bounding boxes, labels, confidence, timestamps, sensor IDs, and track IDs to Kafka and Elasticsearch." Target `{{platform}}`. Exclude embeddings, Search analytics/API, Agent/UI/ingress, Phoenix, and LLM/VLM inference. Validate before deployment, prove live and uploaded paths, and leave services running for verifier probes.
checks: `_builds/in-2-runtime/overrides.env` exists with `BASE_PROFILE=search`, the full effective service set, and only changed environment values.

Ignoring order, the effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES` equals exactly `kibana-init-container-search,nvstreamer-2d-fusion,perception-2d-init,perception-2d-fusion,elasticsearch,elasticsearch-init-container,kafka,kafka-topic-init-container,redis,kibana,logstash,broker-health-check,init-dirs,render-config,wdm-env-from-config,wait-for-redis,wait-for-docker-workloads,sdr-controller,centralizedb,vst-ingress,sensor-ms,streamprocessing-ms`; all explicitly excluded capability keys are absent.
`ENABLE_CRITIC=false` is effective because VLM critique was excluded.
`COMPOSE_PROFILES` contains only current canonical profile keys and contains no build label or invented aggregate profile.
`compose.override.yml` is absent because no service definition changes are required.
No copied profile `.env`, root `compose.yml`, patched tree, manifest, allow-list, or generated skill bundle exists under the build directory.
Compose validation and deployment use the same ordered env layers: `containers.env`, Search `.env`, Search `overrides.env`, and the build `overrides.env`, followed by the root Compose file.
All selected long-running containers are running or healthy, all selected one-shot containers exit 0, and excluded services are not running.
RT-CV readiness succeeds at its configured host port and reports the requested RT-DETR/person configuration.
An uploaded warehouse video is retrievable through VIOS playback or clip APIs.
A live NvStreamer source is registered with VIOS and RT-CV is driven from the actual VIOS live-proxy RTSP URL discovered at runtime.
Kafka `mdx-raw` end offsets are recorded before and after live processing and increase.
Elasticsearch contains RT-CV metadata attributable to the processed sensor, including the requested detection/tracking fields.
No file under `deploy/docker/` is modified, and the final response reports the Base Profile, effective delta, changed knobs, readiness, playback, Kafka, and Elasticsearch evidence.
